summary: Feed c068_span is degraded: 38.95% packet loss due to SPAN oversubscription (1.64 Gbps mirrored into 1 Gbps destination). NDR is missing over a third of traffic, severely reducing detection coverage.

findings.root_cause: SPAN oversubscription on CORE-SW-01: source Gi1/0/1 should copy 12,285,000 packets (1.64 Gbps) but destination Gi1/0/48 is only 1 Gbps at 100% average load and discarded 4,784,940 packets (38.95% loss). SPAN is best-effort and drops when mirrored rate exceeds destination port capacity, especially during bursts.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR receives only 7,500,000 of 12,285,000 packets. With ~39% random loss, flow reassembly, file extraction and behavioral detection are incomplete; attacks can be missed and alerts lack evidence. Tool port is 10 Gbps so loss is upstream, not tool capacity.

params.detail: Replace SPAN with passive TAP on Gi1/0/1 link and deliver via packet broker with lossless 10G handoff to NDR

recommended_fix.why: TAP provides lossless, out-of-band copy independent of switch CPU/buffers and eliminates SPAN destination oversubscription drops, ensuring NDR receives complete traffic for reliable detection.
